45974-ken-ward-in-the-jungle.title: In The Jungle
45974-ken-ward-in-the-jungle.creator: Unknown
45974-ken-ward-in-the-jungle.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was indeed a change for Ken Ward, young forester, pitcher of the varsity nine at school, and hunter of lions in the Arizona cañons. Here he was entering the jungle of the tropics. The rifles and the camp outfit on the seat beside his brother Hal and himself spoke of coming adventures. Before them lay an unknown wilderness--the semi-tropical jungle.

arxiv-2003-14342.title: Fusible numbers and Peano Arithmetic
arxiv-2003-14342.creator: Jeff Erickson ORCID:0000-0002-5253-2282, Gabriel Nivasch ORCID:0000-0001-5960-4253, Junyan Xu ORCID:0000-0002-3789-2319
arxiv-2003-14342.description: Abstract . Inspired by a mathematical riddle involving fuses, we define the fusible numbers as follows: 0 0 is fusible, and whenever x , y x,y are fusible with | y − x | < 1 |y-x|<1 , the number ( x + y + 1 ) / 2 (x+y+1)/2 is also fusible.

arxiv-2105-11481.title: Ultrahigh-Energy Gamma Rays and Gravitational Waves from Primordial Exotic Stellar Bubbles
arxiv-2105-11481.creator: Yi-Fu Cai, Chao Chen, Qianhang Ding, Yi Wang
arxiv-2105-11481.description: Abstract We put forward a novel class of exotic celestial objects that can be produced through phase transitions occurred in the primordial Universe. These objects appear as bubbles of stellar sizes and can be dominated by primordial black holes (PBHs).

arxiv-2107-02814.title: Supersymmetry Breaking and Stability in String Vacua Brane dynamics, bubbles and the swampland
arxiv-2107-02814.creator: Ivano Basile
arxiv-2107-02814.description: Abstract We review some aspects of the dramatic consequences of supersymmetry breaking on string vacua. In particular, we focus on the issue of vacuum stability in ten-dimensional string models with broken, or without, supersymmetry, whose perturbative spectra are free of tachyons.

arxiv-2111-10070.title: Sum Capacity Loss Quantification With Optimal and Sub-Optimal Precoding in Heterogeneous Multiuser Channels
arxiv-2111-10070.creator: Harsh Tataria*, Mansoor Shafi, Dino Pjanić**Ericsson AB, Lund, Sweden
arxiv-2111-10070.description: Abstract We analytically approximate the expected sum capacity loss between the optimal downlink precoding technique of dirty paper coding (DPC), and the sub-optimal technique of zero-forcing precoding, for multiuser channels. We also consider the most general case of multi-stream transmission to multiple users, where we evaluate the expected sum capacity loss between DPC and block diagonalization precoding.

arxiv-2211-07172.title: Pilot-Aided Distributed Multi-Group Multicast Precoding Design for Cell-Free Massive MIMO Thanks: The authors are with the Centre for Wireless Communications, University of Oulu, Finland (e-mail: {bikshapathi.gouda, italo.atzeni, antti.tolli}@oulu.fi). This work is supported by the Research Council
arxiv-2211-07172.creator: Bikshapathi Gouda, Italo Atzeni
arxiv-2211-07172.description: Abstract We propose fully distributed multi-group multicast precoding designs for cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems with modest training overhead. We target the minimization of the sum of the maximum mean squared errors (MSEs) over the multicast groups, which is then approximated with a weighted sum MSE minimization to simplify the computation and signaling.

arxiv-2402-09060.title: Merge and strip – dark matter-free dwarf galaxies in clusters can be formed by galaxy mergers
arxiv-2402-09060.creator: Anna Ivleva, Rhea-Silvia Remus, Lucas M. Valenzuela, Klaus Dolag
arxiv-2402-09060.description: Abstract Context. Recent observations of galaxy mergers inside galaxy cluster environments, such as NGC 5291 in the vicinity of Abell 3574 , report high star formation rates in the ejected tidal tails, which point towards currently developing tidal dwarf galaxies.

arxiv-2407-05281.title: Tail Index Estimation for Discrete Heavy-Tailed Distributions with Application to Statistical Inference for Regular Markov Chains
arxiv-2407-05281.creator: Patrice Bertail, Stephan Clémençon, Carlos Fernández
arxiv-2407-05281.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Patrice Bertail, Stephan Clémençon, Carlos Fernández. It is the purpose of this paper to investigate the issue of estimating the regularity index β > 0 \beta>0 of a discrete heavy-tailed r.v. S S valued in ℕ ∗ \mathbb{N}^{*} such that ℙ ⁡ ( S > n ) = L ⁡ ( n ) ⋅ n − β \mathbb{P}(S>n)=L(n)\cdot n^{-\beta} for all n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 , where L : ℝ + ∗ → ℝ + L:\mathbb{R}^{*}_{+}\to\mathbb{R}_{+} is a slowly varying function.

arxiv-2411-17287.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Regression on Small-Scale and High-Dimensional Biological Data
arxiv-2411-17287.creator: Cem Ata Baykara, Ali Burak Ünal, Nico Pfeifer, Mete Akgün
arxiv-2411-17287.description: Abstract Machine learning models often struggle with generalization in small, heterogeneous datasets due to domain shifts caused by variations in data collection and population differences. This challenge is particularly pronounced in biological data, where data is high-dimensional, small-scale, and decentralized across institutions.

arxiv-2502-06820.title: LoCA: Location-Aware Cosine Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
arxiv-2502-06820.creator: Zhekai Du, Yinjie Min ⋄, Jingjing Li †, Ke Lu †, Changliang Zou ⋄, Liuhua Peng ‡, Tingjin Chu ‡, Mingming Gong † University of Electronic Science and Technology of China ‡ The University of Melbourne ⋄ Nankai University ⋆ Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence {zhekaid, jjl, kel}@ue
arxiv-2502-06820.description: Abstract Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a prevalent method for adapting pre-trained large language models to downstream tasks. However, the simple low-rank decomposition form may constrain the hypothesis space. To address this limitation, we introduce Location-aware Cosine Adaptation (LoCA), a novel frequency-domain parameter-efficient fine-tuning method based on inverse Discrete Cosine Transform (iDCT) with selective locations of learnable components.

arxiv-2509-01314.title: Can Smaller LLMs do better? Unlocking Cross-Domain Potential through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Text Summarization
arxiv-2509-01314.creator: Anum Afzal, Mehul Kumawat, Florian Matthes
arxiv-2509-01314.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs), being generic task solvers, are versatile. However, despite the vast amount of data they are trained on, there are speculations about their adaptation capabilities to a new domain. Additionally, the simple fine-tuning of the model to incorporate knowledge of a new domain is computationally expensive and time-consuming.

arxiv-2510-25448.title: On Type I blowup and ε \varepsilon -regularity criteria of suitable weak solutions to the 3D incompressible MHD equations Thanks: Corresponding author: Zhengce Zhang Thanks: Keywords: MHD equations; Suitable weak solutions; ε \varepsilon -regularity; Type I blowup Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Cl
arxiv-2510-25448.creator: Wentao Hu and Zhengce Zhang
arxiv-2510-25448.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study some new ε \varepsilon -regularity criteria related to the suitable weak solutions to the three-dimensional incompressible MHD equations. Our criteria allow great flexibility: The smallness and boundedness assumptions can be imposed on any scaling-invariant quantities of u u and b b , respectively, which may be chosen independently.

arxiv-2511-00822.title: The CatWISE2020 Quasar dipole: A Reassessment of the Cosmic Dipole Anomaly
arxiv-2511-00822.creator: Masroor Bashir, Pravabati Chingangbam, Stephen Appleby
arxiv-2511-00822.description: Abstract The cosmological principle, which asserts a statistically homogeneous and isotropic universe on large scales, is a foundational assumption of the standard cosmological model. A critical test of this principle involves the kinematic interpretation of the Cosmic Microwave Background temperature dipole, conventionally attributed to our peculiar motion relative to the cosmic rest frame.

arxiv-2512-05237.title: Analog quantum simulation of the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model in a transmon qudit
arxiv-2512-05237.creator: Elizabeth Champion, Annie Schwartz, Muhammad A. Ijaz, Xiaohui Xu, Steve Campbell, Gabriel T. Landi, Machiel S. Blok
arxiv-2512-05237.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Elizabeth Champion, Annie Schwartz, Muhammad A. Ijaz, Xiaohui Xu, Steve Campbell, Gabriel T. Landi, Machiel S. Blok. The simulation of large-scale quantum systems is one of the most sought-after applications of quantum computers. Of particular interest for near-term demonstrations of quantum computational advantage are analog quantum simulations, which employ analog controls instead of digitized gates.

arxiv-2601-12414.title: Tail Structure and the Ordering of the Standard Deviation and Gini Mean Difference
arxiv-2601-12414.creator: Nawaf Mohammed
arxiv-2601-12414.description: Abstract We investigate the ordering between two fundamental measures of dispersion for real-valued risks: the standard deviation (SD) and the Gini mean difference (GMD). Our analysis is driven by a single structural object, namely the mean excess function of the pairwise difference | X − X ′ | |X-X^{\prime}| .

europmc-pmc5769309.title: Colorectal cancer liver metastases - a population-based study on incidence, management and survival.
europmc-pmc5769309.creator: Engstrand J, Nilsson H, Strömberg C, Jonas E, Freedman J.
europmc-pmc5769309.description: Background Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer-associated deaths with liver metastases developing in 25-30% of those affected. Previous data suggest a survival difference between right- and left-sided liver metastatic CRC, even though left-sided cancer has a hig

pmc-10740680.title: Impact of Beta-Lactam Target Attainment on Resistance Development in Patients with Gram-Negative Infections
pmc-10740680.creator: Nicole F. Maranchick, Jessica Webber, Mohammad H. Alshaer, Timothy W. Felton, Charles A. Peloquin
pmc-10740680.description: Background: The objective was to identify associations between beta-lactam pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) targets and Gram-negative bacteria resistance emergence in patients. Methods: Retrospective data were collected between 2016 to 2019 at the University of Florida Health-Shands Hospital in Gainesville, FL. Adult patients with two Gram-negative isolates receiving cefepime, meropenem, or piperacillin-tazobactam and who had plasma beta-lactam concentrations were included.

pmc-11459710.title: Quality of life and social reinsertion of patients on maintenance haemodialysis in four government funded hospitals in Cameroon
pmc-11459710.creator: Denis Georges Teuwafeu, Mervis Sehbing, Marie-Patrice Halle, Maimouna Mahamat, Hermine Fouda, Gloria Ashuntantang
pmc-11459710.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundReduced quality of life is associated with shorter survival in chronic illnesses. However, the health-related quality of life (HRQOL) and social reinsertion of patients on maintenance haemodialysis is much more underappreciated in resource-limited countries such as Cameroon.MethodA hospital-based cross-sectional study was carried out from February 22nd to May 20th, 2022, in 4 government-funded haemodialysis centres in three randomly selected regions of Cameroon. Patients received twice-weekly dialysis sessions.

pmc-11551685.title: Diagnosis of West Nile virus infections: Evaluation of different laboratory methods
pmc-11551685.creator: Tatjana Vilibic-Cavlek, Maja Bogdanic, Vladimir Savic, Zeljka Hruskar, Ljubo Barbic, Vladimir Stevanovic, Ljiljana Antolasic, Ljiljana Milasincic, Dario Sabadi, Gorana Miletic, Ivona Coric, Anna Mrzljak, Eddy Listes, Giovanni Savini
pmc-11551685.description: BACKGROUNDThe diagnosis of West Nile virus (WNV) is challenging due to short-term and low-level viremia, flavivirus cross-reactivity, and long immunoglobulin M (IgM) persistence.AIMTo evaluate different methods for WNV detection [reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), IgM/IgG antibodies, IgG avidity] in serum, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), and urine samples of patients with confirmed WNV infection.

pmc-11646046.title: P090 Assessment of the seal, comfort, usability and performance of an ultra-compact full-face PAP mask in comparison to a competitor mask
pmc-11646046.creator: J Bindra, S Ghamedi, L Camacho, N Banodkar, R Deas, X Zhu, F Sert Kuniyoshi, B Dauphin, M Uhles
pmc-11646046.description: IntroductionPositive Airway Pressure (PAP) is the standard treatment for Obstructive Sleep Apnoea (OSA), with a well-fitting mask crucial for adherence. The Oran Park (OP) mask combines full-face performance with an ultra-compact design, featuring a soft, adaptable silicone cushion for all-night comfort.

pmc-12008351.title: Sonographic Predictors for Developing Cholangiocarcinoma: A Cohort Study from an Endemic Area
pmc-12008351.creator: Natcha Thanakijsombat, Kamonwan Soonklang, Pantajaree Hiranrat, Poemporn Limpisook, Surachate Siripongsakun
pmc-12008351.description: Background and Aim:Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is an aggressive malignancy with a poor prognosis. Bile duct and peribiliary changes related to CCA may present on ultrasound (US) findings. This study aims to evaluate US findings that could be used as predictors for developing CCA through our surveillance program in an endemic area of Thailand.

pmc-12420520.title: Screening and validation of diagnostic markers for keloids via bioinformatics analysis
pmc-12420520.creator: Ze Wang, Bo Hu, Wenfei Li, Tengxiao Ma, Lei Li
pmc-12420520.description: BackgroundKeloid (KD) disease is a skin lesions caused by abnormal wound healing that involve complex cellular and molecular mechanisms. The aim of this study was to screen diagnostic markers of KD via bioinformatics methods and evaluate their clinical application value.

pmc-12429354.title: Machine Learning Integration of Bulk and Single-Cell RNA-Seq Data Reveals Cathepsin B as a Central PANoptosis Regulator in Influenza
pmc-12429354.creator: Bin Liu, Lin Zhu, Caijuan Zhang, Dunfang Wang, Haifan Liu, Jianyao Liu, Jingwei Sun, Xue Feng, Weipeng Yang
pmc-12429354.description: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection triggers excessive activation of PANoptosis—a coordinated form of programmed cell death integrating pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis—which contributes to severe immunopathology and acute lung injury. However, the molecular regulators that drive PANoptosis during IAV infection remain poorly understood.

pmc-13372035.title: An evaluation of the impact of a national facilitated antimicrobial stewardship e-learning course on learners’ practice in Egypt
pmc-13372035.creator: Jacqueline Sneddon, Ryan A Hamilton, Yara Khalaf, Hannah Stewart, Tracey Guise, Elizabeth Tayler, Dilip Nathwani
pmc-13372035.description: BackgroundIn Egypt, the political commitment to addressing antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is increasing and there is an ambition to rapidly scale up antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) in hospitals. The British Society for Antimicrobial Chemotherapy (BSAC) partnered with World Health Organization (WHO) Egypt to support this goal through structured education and training.

pmc-13602321.title: Circulating tumor DNA tumor fraction as a biomarker in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer: findings from the CAVE-2 GOIM trial
pmc-13602321.creator: Davide Ciardiello, Giulia Martini, Luca Boscolo Bielo, Gloria Pellizzari, Filippo Pietrantonio, Paola Andena, Silvia Marchesi, Salvatore Pisconti, Claudia Nisi, Giampaolo Tortora, Lisa Salvatore, Andrea Sartore-Bianchi, Salvatore Siena, Federica Papaccio, Marco Messina, Elena Ongaro, Alberto Zanibon
pmc-13602321.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Liquid biopsy guided anti-EGFR rechallenge therapy is gaining ground as a potential option for patient with refractory metastatic colorectal cancer. However, the identification of potential biomarkers to implement patient's stratification is required. The CAVE-2 GOIM trial investigated the role of rechallenge with cetuximab ± avelumab in patients with circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) (assessed with the FoundationOne Liquid assay) RAS/BRAF wild type (WT) mCRC. Correlation with molecular profile, ctDNA tumor fraction (TF), and clinicopathological characteristics was performed.
